{'text': 'Apple TV renews «Carême»', 'empty': False}

{'text': 'Apple TV this morning announced that «Carême», starring Benjamin Voisin, has been renewed for a second season, with filming scheduled to begin next week in Paris.', 'empty': False}

{'text': "«Carême» premiered last April with a total of 8 episodes and holds an average IMDb rating of 7.9/10. The series is adapted from Ian Kelly's book «Carême: The First Celebrity Chef» and is currently nominated at the International Emmy Awards in the drama series category. The show's original score and theme song have each received nominations at two Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA).", 'empty': False}

{'text': 'The 54th International Emmy Awards ceremony is scheduled for November 23 in New York, while the 17th annual HMMA will be held a few days earlier, on November 18 in Hollywood.', 'empty': False}
